'''Sahl-Evin''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] [[City/Legends|city]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jenenma]]. At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Force Adept|Force adept]] [[Pal-Nada]] used his [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] to gain control of the [[Blinders district]] of Sahl-Evin, an industrial region of the city.
